variants.cost: The displayed implementation uses 2K exact full G evaluations to produce z^K, each equivalent to one full gradient with a block sign change. Separately evaluating the returned residual costs one additional query unless already available. Direct vector arithmetic and anchor/current/temporary storage are separate O(n+m) resources per step. No projection or proximal query appears.
variants.name: EAG-C
variants.output: Return the last outer iterate z^K; no averaging or best-point selection.
variants.query_and_update: For j=0,...,K-1 set a_j=z^j+(z0-z^j)/(j+2); query g_j=G(z^j); set w_j=a_j-alpha*g_j; query h_j=G(w_j); set z^(j+1)=a_j-alpha*h_j. Both updates use a_j as their base.
variants.requirements: Exact G(z)=(grad_x L,-grad_y L) on all of R^(n+m). The linked guarantee assumes differentiable convex-concave L, R-Lipschitz G, a saddle point, and the stated step-size conditions.
variants.state_and_initialization: Set z^0=z0 and keep this anchor fixed; store the current z^j. No initial saddle point is required.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Theorem 1 requires 1-3 alpha R-alpha^2 R^2-alpha^3 R^3>=0 and 1-8 alpha R+alpha^2 R^2-2 alpha^3 R^3>=0. Corollary 1 permits 0<alpha<=1/(8R), with the explicit 260 bound at alpha=1/(8R). Stop after K outer steps; no residual stopping rule is asserted.
